lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਕੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਉਸੁ ਸੂਅਰ ਉਸੁ ਗਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hak paraaiaa naanakaa us sooar us gaai ||
lines.translation: : To take what rightfully belongs to another, is like a Muslim eating pork, or a Hindu eating beef.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ਹਾਮਾ ਤਾ ਭਰੇ ਜਾ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur peer haamaa taa bhare jaa muradaar na khaai ||
lines.translation: Our Guru, our Spiritual Guide, stands by us, if we do not eat those carcasses.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਲੀ ਭਿਸਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਛੁਟੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: galee bhisat na jaaeeai chhutai sach kamaai ||
lines.translation: By mere talk, people do not earn passage to Heaven. Salvation comes only from the practice of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਣ ਪਾਹਿ ਹਰਾਮ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaran paahi haraam mahi hoi halaal na jaai ||
lines.translation: By adding spices to forbidden foods, they are not made acceptable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਲੀ ਕੂੜੀਈ ਕੂੜੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak galee kooReeee kooRo palai paai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, from false talk, only falsehood is obtained. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ਵਖਤ ਪੰਜਿ ਪੰਜਾ ਪੰਜੇ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)j nivaajaa vakhat pa(n)j pa(n)jaa pa(n)je naau ||
lines.translation: There are five prayers and five times of day for prayer; the five have five names.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਹਲਾਲ ਦੁਇ ਤੀਜਾ ਖੈਰ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahilaa sach halaal dui teejaa khair khudaai ||
lines.translation: Let the first be truthfulness, the second honest living, and the third charity in the Name of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੀ ਨੀਅਤਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਜਵੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chauthee neeat raas man pa(n)javee siphat sanaai ||
lines.translation: Let the fourth be good will to all, and the fifth the praise of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਲਮਾ ਆਖਿ ਕੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਸਦਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: karanee kalamaa aakh kai taa musalamaan sadaai ||
lines.translation: Repeat the prayer of good deeds, and then, you may call yourself a Muslim.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇਤੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jete kooRiaar kooRai kooRee paai ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the false obtain falsehood, and only falsehood. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਵਣਜਦੇ ਇਕਿ ਕਚੈ ਦੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik ratan padaarath vanajade ik kachai de vaapaaraa ||
lines.translation: Some trade in priceless jewels, while others deal in mere glass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur tuthai paaeean a(n)dar ratan bha(n)daaraa ||
lines.translation: When the True Guru is pleased, we find the treasure of the jewel, deep within the self.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਲਧਿਆ ਅੰਧੇ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin gur kinai na ladhiaa a(n)dhe bhauk mue kooRiaaraa ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, no one has found this treasure. The blind and the false have died in their endless wanderings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh doojai pach mue naa boojhahi veechaaraa ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs putrefy and die in duality. They do not understand contemplative meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikas baajhahu doojaa ko nahee kis agai karahi pukaaraa ||
lines.translation: Without the One Lord, there is no other at all. Unto whom should they complain?

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਸਦਾ ਭਉਕਦੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਭਰੇ ਤੁਜਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik niradhan sadaa bhaukade ikanaa bhare tujaaraa ||
lines.translation: Some are destitute, and wander around endlessly, while others have storehouses of wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin naavai hor dhan naahee hor bikhiaa sabh chhaaraa ||
lines.translation: Without God's Name, there is no other wealth. Everything else is just poison and ashes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aap karaae kare aap hukam savaaranahaaraa ||7||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself acts, and causes others to act; by the Hukam of His Command, we are embellished and exalted. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਕਹਾਵਣੁ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: musalamaan kahaavan musakal jaa hoi taa musalamaan kahaavai ||
lines.translation: It is difficult to be called a Muslim; if one is truly a Muslim, then he may be called one.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਲਿ ਅਉਲਿ ਦੀਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਠਾ ਮਸਕਲ ਮਾਨਾ ਮਾਲੁ ਮੁਸਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aval aul deen kar mithaa masakal maanaa maal musaavai ||
lines.translation: First, let him savor the religion of the Prophet as sweet; then, let his pride of his possessions be scraped away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਮੁਸਲਿਮੁ ਦੀਨ ਮੁਹਾਣੈ ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hoi musalim deen muhaanai maran jeevan kaa bharam chukaavai ||
lines.translation: Becoming a true Muslim, a disciple of the faith of Mohammed, let him put aside the delusion of death and life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਬ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਿਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: rab kee rajaai ma(n)ne sir upar karataa ma(n)ne aap gavaavai ||
lines.translation: As he submits to God's Will, and surrenders to the Creator, he is rid of selfishness and conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਮਿਹਰੰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tau naanak sarab jeeaa mihara(n)mat hoi ta musalamaan kahaavai ||1||
lines.translation: And when, O Nanak, he is merciful to all beings, only then shall he be called a Muslim. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤਜਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: parahar kaam krodh jhooth ni(n)daa taj maaiaa aha(n)kaar chukaavai ||
lines.translation: Renounce sexual desire, anger, falsehood and slander; forsake Maya and eliminate egotistical pride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਜੈ ਤਾ ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj kaam kaaminee mohu tajai taa a(n)jan maahi nira(n)jan paavai ||
lines.translation: Renounce sexual desire and promiscuity, and give up emotional attachment. Only then shall you obtain the Immaculate Lord amidst the darkness of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਤਜਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਆਸ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj maan abhimaan preet sut daaraa taj piaas aas raam liv laavai ||
lines.translation: Renounce selfishness, conceit and arrogant pride, and your love for your children and spouse. Abandon your thirsty hopes and desires, and embrace love for the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saachaa man vasai saach sabad har naam samaavai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the True One shall come to dwell in your mind. Through the True Word of the Shabad, you shall be absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੇ ਰਯਤਿ ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਹਸੀਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaje rayat sikadaar koi na rahaseeo ||
lines.translation: Neither the kings, nor their subjects, nor the leaders shall remain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਾਜਾਰ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਢਹਸੀਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: hat patan baajaar hukamee dhahaseeo ||
lines.translation: The shops, the cities and the streets shall eventually disintegrate, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਕੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pake ba(n)k duaar moorakh jaanai aapane ||
lines.translation: Those solid and beautiful mansions-the fools think that they belong to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਬਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਰੀਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਖਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: darab bhare bha(n)daar reete ik khane ||
lines.translation: The treasure-houses, filled with wealth, shall be emptied out in an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਜੀ ਰਥ ਤੁਖਾਰ ਹਾਥੀ ਪਾਖਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: taajee rath tukhaar haathee paakhare ||
lines.translation: The horses, chariots, camels and elephants, with all their decorations;

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਗ ਮਿਲਖ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ਕਿਥੈ ਸਿ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baag milakh ghar baar kithai s aapane ||
lines.translation: the gardens, lands, houses, tents, soft beds and satin pavilions -

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੰਬੂ ਪਲੰਘ ਨਿਵਾਰ ਸਰਾਇਚੇ ਲਾਲਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ta(n)boo pala(n)gh nivaar saraaiche laalatee ||
lines.translation: Oh, where are those things, which they believe to be their own?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਿਨਾਖਤੁ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sach daataar sinaakhat kudaratee ||8||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the True One is the Giver of all; He is revealed through His All-powerful Creative Nature. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦੀਆ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਧੇਣਵਾ ਸੁੰਮ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦੁਧੁ ਘੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadeeaa hovahi dhenavaa su(n)m hovahi dudh gheeu ||
lines.translation: If the rivers became cows, giving milk, and the spring water became milk and ghee;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਕਰ ਹੋਵੈ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagalee dharatee sakar hovai khusee kare nit jeeu ||
lines.translation: If all the earth became sugar, to continually excite the mind;
